Water Main Renewal Program

You are here: Home1 / Our community2 / Projects3 / Current projects4 / Water Main Renewal Program

Westernport Water have replaced aging water mains to maintain reliable water supply for the community.

The 1-million-dollar renewal program is part of our broader investment in water infrastructure to enhance network resilience to meet current and future demand.

Five sites across Ventnor, Sunderland Bay, Surf Beach and Newhaven were upgraded in 2025 and 2026.

When and where did works occur?

Works commenced in mid-April 2025 and were completed at the sites below by early 2026.

  1. The Esplanade, Ventnor – COMPLETE
  2. The Esplanade, Sunderland Bay – COMPLETE
  3. Sinclair Avenue, Surf Beach – COMPLETE
  4. Fern Avenue, Surf Beach – COMPLETE
  5. Forrest Avenue & Anderson Street, Newhaven – COMPLETE

About Us

Westernport Water is responsible for supplying drinking water, recycled water, and sewerage services to customers on Phillip Island and the district between Archies Creek and The Gurdies.
